document: IStructE/Concrete Society SMDS — Chapters 5 (continued) & 6 (Slabs, Beams, Columns partial)

non_preferred_sizes_note.6mm: not commonly available — low demand and infrequent rollings
non_preferred_sizes_note.50mm: not generally stocked — order cut to length from mill; consider 40mm in bundles instead

actual_vs_nominal_size_mm.note: Nominal size is diameter of circle with area equal to effective cross-section. Most deformed bars contained in circle 10% larger. Individual sections can measure 13-14% more at largest cross-dimension.

bar_areas_and_mass.mass_basis: 0.00785 kg per mm2 per metre run

stock_lengths.note_exceeding_12m: Extra cost and delays may be involved if 12m exceeded
stock_lengths.bent_bar_transportability: Shape must be contained by imaginary rectangle where shortest side does not exceed 2.75m

rebending_bars.general_rule: Generally rebending bars on site should not be permitted
rebending_bars.exception_class_B_or_C_le_12mm: May be rebent provided mandrel not reduced below 4 × bar size, and bars are sufficiently ductile (Class B or C)
rebending_bars.exception_larger_bars: Only within a proprietary system with Technical Approval from accredited body (e.g. CARES UK) and testing showing no damage
rebending_bars.warning: Rebending can cause damage to concrete surface

large_diameter_bends_required_where: end of column and wall connections to beams or slabs
chapter_5_general.large_diameter_bends_note: Designer normally responsible for calculation; tables at end of manual give mandrel sizes

type_A_square.description: equal wire size both directions, 200mm centres

type_B_structural.description: main in long direction at 100mm centres, transverse at 200mm

type_D49.description: lightweight, often used for crack control

fabric_reinforcement.flying_end_fabric: Extended overhangs — eliminate layer build-up at laps
fabric_reinforcement.bending: Generally all fabrics can be cut and bent to most BS shapes; wire > 12mm may not be possible by automatic machine

purposes: safe transmission of bond forces: min cover >= bar size (or equivalent for bundles)
cover.cover_to_link_rule: Nominal cover to link must result in cover to main bar >= main bar size + Δcdev
cover.surface_treatment_rule: Add expected depth of surface treatment to nominal cover
cover.cover_for_durability: Exposure class governs — specified by Designer (EC2, Clause 4.2)
cover.cover_for_fire: Axis distance — specified by Designer (BS EN 1992-1-2)
cover.fire_axis_distance_note: BS EN 1992-1-2 uses axis distance = distance from centre of bar to concrete surface

fixing_reinforcement_for_cover.tying: No. 16 gauge annealed soft iron wire — not every intersection needed
fixing_reinforcement_for_cover.spacers_chairs: Most common method; BS 7973 provides specification
fixing_reinforcement_for_cover.beam_bar_spacers: Short lengths of bar; specify spacing on drawings (usually 1m); detail in schedules

minimum_clear_spacing.rule: min(bar_size, dg + 5mm, 20mm) where dg = max aggregate size
minimum_clear_spacing.horizontal_layers: Bars in each layer located vertically above each other; sufficient space for vibrators

cutting_bending_tolerances.cutting_length: sum of bending dimensions and allowances, rounded UP to nearest 25mm

closed_detailing_tolerances.description: Deduction from nominal concrete dimension for bars fitting between two concrete faces (beams, columns)
closed_detailing_tolerances.assumption: Member size tolerance: 5mm for size up to 2m, 10mm otherwise. Plus allowance for bar deformities.

example_1_beam_corner.description: H16 link with H40 main bar

example_2_beam_column_junction.description: H12 link, 5 × H32 beam bars, column width 275mm with 40mm cover each side
example_2_beam_column_junction.conclusion: Bars will not fit — tolerance deduction has real physical consequence

example_3_flanged_beam.description: Gap between bars A and B is 3mm without tolerances. With 5mm link tolerance and actual bar size, bar A could be 12mm lower; bar B cover could be <10mm if formwork 2-3mm out.

good: unhatched zones in members h > 250mm (lower 250mm and inclined bars)
poor: hatched zones in members h > 250mm (above 250mm from bottom)
hatched zones in members h > 600mm (above 300mm from bottom)

design_anchorage_length.formula: l_bd = α1 × α2 × α3 × α4 × α5 × l_b,rqd ≥ l_b,min
design_anchorage_length.direct_support_exception: l_bd may be less than l_b,min if at least one transverse wire welded ≥15mm from face of support

design_lap_length.formula: l_0 = α1 × α2 × α3 × α5 × α6 × l_b,rqd ≥ l_0,min

alpha6.ρ1_definition: percentage of reinforcement lapped within 0.65 × l_0 from centre of lap

design_lap_length.compression_all: All bars in compression may be lapped in one section
design_lap_length.secondary_distribution_all: All secondary (distribution) bars may be lapped in one section

lap_arrangement_rules.stagger: Laps should normally be staggered, not in areas of high moments/forces (e.g. plastic hinges)
lap_arrangement_rules.symmetric: Should normally be arranged symmetrically in any section
lap_arrangement_rules.clear_distance_between_lapped_bars_max: 4ø or 50mm; otherwise increase lap length by excess clear space

tension_small_bars_or_few_lapped.condition: bar dia < 20mm OR lapped bars < 25% of section
tension_small_bars_or_few_lapped.rule: Existing transverse reinforcement/links sufficient — no additional justification needed

tension_large_bars.rule: Total area Ast (legs parallel to spliced reinforcement) >= area As of one lapped bar
tension_large_bars.position: Perpendicular to lapped reinforcement, between it and concrete surface

more_than_50_percent_lapped_adjacent.condition: more than 50% lapped AND distance a between adjacent laps ≤ 10ø
more_than_50_percent_lapped_adjacent.rule: Transverse reinforcement must be links or U-bars anchored in body of section
more_than_50_percent_lapped_adjacent.position: At outer sections of lap — see Figure 5.6(a)

compression.extra_rule: One bar of transverse reinforcement outside each end of lap AND within 4ø of lap end

large_bars_gt_40mm.splitting_forces: Higher splitting forces and dowel action
large_bars_gt_40mm.no_lapping_except: Sections with minimum dimension ≥ 1m OR stress ≤ 80% design ultimate
large_bars_gt_40mm.surface_reinforcement: May be required for crack control (EC2 7.3.4, 8.8, 9.2.4)

bundled_bars.same_characteristics: All bars in bundle same type and grade
bundled_bars.two_touching_bars_vertically_good_bond: Need not be treated as bundle

anchorage.bn_lt_32mm_in_tension: May be curtailed near support without staggering
anchorage.bn_ge_32mm_in_tension: Must be staggered in longitudinal direction (see Figure 5.8)
anchorage.stagger_distance_gt_1_3_lb_rqd: May use bar diameter (not bn) for lbd
anchorage.compression_bn_ge_32mm_links: At least 4 links dia ≥ 12mm at ends of bundle; plus one just beyond curtailed bar end

lapping.two_bars_bn_lt_32mm: May be lapped without staggering; use bn for l_0
lapping.two_bars_bn_ge_32mm_or_three_bars: Individual bars staggered by ≥ 1.3l_0 (Figure 5.9); bar 4 used as lapping bar

main_reinforcement_intermeshed.rule: Per 5.3.3; ignore favourable effects of transverse bars (α3 = 1.0)

main_reinforcement_layered.stress_condition: Generally in zones where stress ≤ 80% design strength

minimum_lap_table.dia_le_6mm: ≥ 150mm and at least 1 wire pitch within lap

mechanical_couplers.cover_rule: Cover for couplers = cover specified for reinforcement
mechanical_couplers.certification_UK: Must be from company holding valid third party technical approval (CARES UK, BBA etc.)

types_detail.type_1a: Parallel thread, threaded portion smaller diameter than bar — rarely used (reduced load capacity)
types_detail.type_1b: Parallel thread, threaded area ≥ nominal bar area — widely used
types_detail.type_2: Taper-cut threads — popular for standard rotation cases; positional/transitional variants for non-rotation
types_detail.type_3: Integral threads over full length bar (helical deformations) with locknuts
types_detail.type_4: Metal sleeve swaged hydraulically — wholly in-situ; large bars ≥H40 may need mechanical support
types_detail.type_5: Threaded couplers swaged on bar ends joined by threaded stud
types_detail.type_6: Wedge locking — compression only; bar faces must be cut accurately within 3° tolerance
types_detail.type_7: Shear bolts and serrated saddles — no threading required; visual install check (bolt heads shear off)

welding.if_essential: Comply with BS EN 287-1, BS EN 288-3, BS EN 1011-2 and CARES Appendices 6 and 10
welding.tack_welding_on_site: Should not be permitted except with special approval

scope.note: Six or more layers may be required for irregular slabs

tension.formula: As,min = 0.26 × bt × d × fctm / fyk ≥ 0.0013 × bt × d
tension.also_nominal: Same formula applies for nominal reinforcement

minimum_reinforcement_solid_slab.min_top_at_support_partial_fixity: 25% of max required in span (not less than As,min); may be reduced to 15% for end support
minimum_reinforcement_solid_slab.secondary_transverse: 20% of main reinforcement (except near continuous wall supports with no transverse bending)

minimum_reinforcement_cantilever_slab.exposed_cantilever_bottom_in_span: Relate to top reinforcement (say 50%) where shrinkage and temperature affect deflection

minimum_reinforcement_ribbed_slab.fabric_spacing: Wire spacing must not exceed half the pitch of ribs

table_6_1.note2: ≤33% bars lapped at one place, α6=1.15

anchorage_lap_lengths_slab.direct_support_reduction: Anchorage beyond face of support may be reduced to d, but ≥ max(0.3×l_b,rqd; 10ø; 100mm)

top_bars_internal_support.if_difference_lt_500mm: Make all bars equal to greater value
top_bars_internal_support.end_supports: Alternately staggered, normally as two sets of U-bars

curtailment_slabs.bottom_bars_internal_bay: Length = greater of a and b; alternate bars staggered
curtailment_slabs.bottom_bars_end_bay: Alternate bars of lengths a and b

flat_slab_rules.column_strip_width: Normally half the shorter panel dimension
flat_slab_rules.column_drop_strip_width: Set equal to column drop width
flat_slab_rules.aspect_ratio_gt_2_one_way_zone: Distribution reinforcement parallel to short side in centre
flat_slab_rules.negative_moment_concentration: 2/3 of column strip negative moment in centre half of column strip

torsion_reinforcement_slab_corners.condition: Corners held down on both sides
torsion_reinforcement_slab_corners.area_each_leg: ≥ 3/4 of area for maximum mid-span design moment

edge_reinforcement.location: Along free (unsupported) edges and corners supported on both sides

medium_holes_sides_le_500mm.option_1: Displace affected bars equally either side of hole
medium_holes_sides_le_500mm.option_2: Cut/slide bars to face of hole; compensating bars of equal area; trimmers extend min 45ø beyond hole

large_holes_sides_500_to_1000mm.extra: Also trim top of holes with similar bars
large_holes_sides_500_to_1000mm.diagonal_reinforcement: If depth > 250mm, provide diagonal reinforcement of similar area in top and bottom (consider congestion of multiple layers)

structurally_insignificant_rules.groups_boundary_le_500mm: Trim as single hole per medium hole rules
structurally_insignificant_rules.groups_boundary_500_to_1000mm: Trim as single hole per large hole rules

punching_shear.placement_zone: Between loaded area/column and 1.5d inside outer control perimeter; min 1.5d from column

model_detail_MS6.perimeter_spacing: 0.75d from column face; link leg perimeters at 0.75d centres

punching_shear.source: Section 6.2.2, Figure 6.10, Model Detail MS6, pages 58-59, 71

MS1.name: One and two way slabs — Span and internal support
MS1.note: Not less than 2 bars of distribution reinforcement

MS2.name: One and two way slabs — External restrained supports
MS2.detail_B_when_X_lt_anchorage: Straight bar with tension anchorage length; bearing stress inside bend must not exceed limit
MS2.detail_C: Non-standard bend radius required if bearing stress governs

MS3.name: One and two way slabs — External unrestrained supports (also free edges)

MS4.name: Cantilever slabs
MS4.top_bar_min_length: 2 × cantilever length over simple supports; alternately staggered

MS5.name: Flat slabs — Span and internal support
MS5.column_strip_2_3_concentration: 2/3 of bars in centre half when equiv. column dia < 0.15 × panel width
MS5.fire_rating_R90_plus: Distribution bars area ≥ 20% of total top design reinforcement

model_details_slabs.MS6: Flat slab shear reinforcement (see punching_shear above)

MS8.name: Ribbed and coffered slabs
MS8.fabric_nominal: A252 (unless greater specified; check lap lengths per EC2 Cl.8.7.5)
MS8.cover_exceeds_40mm: Supplementary reinforcement for fire — 6mm links max pitch 200mm plus nominal lacer bar (coffered)

chapter_6_beams.scope: Straight suspended beams with defined supports. Not ground beams (see 6.7). Holes require specific design instructions.

nominal_cover_beams.fire_4hr_note: Supplementary reinforcement may be needed if nominal cover > 40mm (axis distance to link > 70mm); see EC2 Part 1.2 Clause 4.5.2

bar_spacing_beams.max_pitch_compression_restrained_conditi: All main bars in compression zone within 150mm of a restrained bar

side_face_bars.location: Inside links at sides of beam

links.min_area: Asw/s × bw ≥ 0.085% where bw = avg breadth below upper flange
links.arrangement: Preferred arrangements per Figure 6.19; overlapping links NOT recommended (Figure 6.20)
links.open_links_with_locking: Permitted for beam-slab with rib width ≥ 450mm; use L-hooks with top locking link (Figure 6.21); hook 10ø, min 75mm

curtailment_beams.curtailment_length_from_design: l_bd + al from line of contact between beam and support
simplified_rules_conditions: Effective span L = min(clear span + d, actual span)

hanger_bars.area: ≥ max(20% max support area, compression area required)

top_bars_internal_support.min_60_percent_continues_to: Point where hanger bars sufficient + tension lap OR zero moment point

bottom_splice_bars_internal_support.min_area: Not less than minimum reinforcement; ≥ 30% max span area
bottom_splice_bars_internal_support.extension: Tension lap with main bottom bars OR compression lap (if in compression) to end of compression zone

bottom_bars_in_span.continuous_beams_min_continuous: 30% of max span area to 25mm from support
bottom_bars_in_span.simply_supported_min_continuous: 50% of max span area to 25mm from support

u_bars_at_end.area: max(tension area for support moment, 30% max span area [50% for simple supports])
u_bars_at_end.top_leg_length: Same as for internal support bars
u_bars_at_end.bottom_leg_length: Same as internal support splice bars
u_bars_at_end.simple_support_crack_control: Sufficient top steel for crack control; replace U-bars with L-bars (top and bottom) if much less than bottom
u_bars_at_end.extension_from_support: Tension lap, both top and bottom

curtailment_beams.partial_fixity_monolithic: Design for bending moment ≥ 0.15 × max span moment even with simple supports assumed
curtailment_beams.cantilever_curtailment: Always relate to bending moment diagram; ≥ 50% continues to end of cantilever

flanged_beams.tension_reinforcement: Spread over effective flange width; part may be concentrated over web

effective_flange_width.cantilever_rule: l3 < half adjacent span; ratio adjacent spans between 1/2 and 1/1

edge_support_connections.do_not_bend_top_bars_up: Bending top bars up into column is NOT recommended
edge_support_connections.narrow_edge_support_anchorage_option_1: 12ø beyond centre of support; no bend before centre of support
edge_support_connections.narrow_edge_support_anchorage_option_2: 12ø + d/2 from face of support; no bend before d/2 from face

deep_beams.min_reinforcement_per_face: max(0.001Ac, 150mm²/m) in each face and each direction
deep_beams.main_tension_anchorage: Fully anchored at support node by bending, U-bars or mechanical anchorage

MB1.name: Span and support details
MB1.bottom_splice_bars: Inside main bars; area ≥ 30% max span area
MB1.closer_bars: Used with open links for beam width ≥ 300mm

MB2.name: Broad shallow sections
MB2.external_support_anchorage: Treat as for slabs (see Model Detail MS2)

chapter_6_columns.scope: In-situ rectangular and circular columns. Not applicable for earthquake. Walls (b/t > 4) covered in 6.5.

nominal_cover_columns.cover_gt_40mm_fire_risk: Surface reinforcement required — mesh spacing ≤ 100mm, dia ≥ 4mm

maximum_reinforcement.congestion_note: Use mechanical splices where congestion is a problem

table_6_5.notes: Good bond conditions; bar ≤ 32mm; α1=α2=α4=α5=1.0; α3=0.9 (λ=1.35, K=0.05). Lap: α6=1.5 (>50% bars lapped at once)

links.bundled_bars_link_size: Based on equivalent single bar of same area
links.arrangement: Overall enclosing link + additional restraining links for alternate bars or bundles; no additional links if all compression bars within 150mm of restrained bar
links.circular_columns: No additional links required beyond overall enclosing link
links.spacing_reduction_at_beam_slab: Reduce by factor 0.6 within distance = larger column dim above and below beam/slab
links.spacing_at_crank: Link must be close to cranking position; ignore if change in direction ≤ 1:12

links_for_bursting_at_laps.total_transverse_area: ΣAst ≥ 1.0 × As (area of one lapped bar)
links_for_bursting_at_laps.position: At outer sections of lap (see Figure 6.25)
links_for_bursting_at_laps.geometry: l0/3 from each end of lap; ΣAst/2 at each end; 4ø from end of lap

moment_connection_beam_edge_column.preferred: U-bars within depth of beam (fixed with beam; no precise fixing during column concreting)
moment_connection_beam_edge_column.when_use_L_bars: When distance A (Figure 6.26) < anchorage length for that bar dia
moment_connection_beam_edge_column.L_bar_note: Must be fixed accurately at top of column lift — difficult site task
moment_connection_beam_edge_column.standard_bend_ok_if: Bar of same or greater size placed inside corner normal to it
moment_connection_beam_edge_column.non_standard_bend: Required if no corner bar; check reinforcement fits and performs correctly
moment_connection_beam_edge_column.shear_capacity_control: Max tensile beam reinforcement also controlled by column shear capacity
moment_connection_beam_edge_column.transverse_column_rebar_in_depth: Required where no edge beam intersects at same level (links or horizontal U-bars)

chapter_6_columns.bursting_action: Links may be required at change of column section (especially edge/corner); may extend within or below beam/slab depth

starter_bars.note: Length specified longer than required from pad footings/pile caps due to construction tolerance risk
